summary: Preserve runtime brand checking for private element access when the receiver type is not statically guaranteed.

target.notes: Check the defining class's private brand on the receiver and throw JavaScript TypeError on failure before reading/writing the private slot.

caveats: Do not approximate private access with dictionary lookup by string '#x'; private names are not ordinary property keys.

tests.name: wrong object throws
tests.input: class C { #x=1; static read(o){ return o.#x; } } C.read({});

tests.name: edge: correct instance succeeds
tests.input: class C { #x=1; static read(o){ return o.#x; } } console.log(C.read(new C()));
